transit_sun_in_aries.title: Transiting Sun in Aries
transit_sun_in_aries.summary: Your core identity surges forward with raw initiative and a hunger to claim new territory.
transit_sun_in_aries.fullText: Like Helios rising in the chariot of Ares, the Sun in Aries ignites a period of bold self-assertion. You feel compelled to act first and refine later; hesitation feels like betrayal of your own fire. Expect heightened drive, quicker temper, and a strong urge to pioneer something that carries your name.

transit_sun_in_taurus.title: Transiting Sun in Taurus
transit_sun_in_taurus.summary: Your sense of self slows down and roots into what feels solid, sensual, and worth keeping.
transit_sun_in_taurus.fullText: Helios now walks the pastures of Aphrodite’s earthier domain. Stability, pleasure, and tangible results become the measure of success. You may resist change that threatens comfort, yet this is also a fertile window for building lasting resources and embodying self-worth through the physical world.

transit_sun_in_gemini.title: Transiting Sun in Gemini
transit_sun_in_gemini.summary: Your identity becomes more curious, restless, and eager to gather information from every direction.
transit_sun_in_gemini.fullText: The solar light takes on the quicksilver mind of Hermes. You thrive on variety, conversation, and mental stimulation; monotony feels stifling. Expect a busier social and intellectual life, though scattered focus is the main risk if you don’t choose a few threads to follow deeply.

transit_sun_in_cancer.title: Transiting Sun in Cancer
transit_sun_in_cancer.summary: Your core self turns inward toward emotional safety, belonging, and the protection of what feels like home.
transit_sun_in_cancer.fullText: Helios now sails under the influence of Selene and the nurturing waters. Moods color your sense of identity more strongly than usual. This is a time to tend to family, roots, and private emotional foundations; public ambition may take a back seat to the need to feel secure.

transit_sun_in_leo.title: Transiting Sun in Leo
transit_sun_in_leo.summary: Your identity expands with warmth, creativity, and a desire to be seen and appreciated.
transit_sun_in_leo.fullText: The Sun returns to its own sign, radiating like Apollo in full glory. Self-expression, play, and recognition become central. You may feel more dramatic or generous, but also more sensitive to anything that dims your light. This is prime time to create, perform, or simply allow yourself to shine without apology.

transit_sun_in_virgo.title: Transiting Sun in Virgo
transit_sun_in_virgo.summary: Your sense of self becomes more discerning, practical, and focused on refinement and usefulness.
transit_sun_in_virgo.fullText: Helios now works under the meticulous eye of Hermes in his more analytical guise. You notice flaws and details that others overlook and feel driven to improve systems, health, or daily routines. Pride shifts toward competence rather than spectacle; perfectionism is the shadow to watch.

transit_sun_in_libra.title: Transiting Sun in Libra
transit_sun_in_libra.summary: Your identity seeks balance, harmony, and meaningful connection with others.
transit_sun_in_libra.fullText: The solar force moves into Aphrodite’s relational domain. Partnerships, fairness, and aesthetic refinement color how you see yourself. Decisions may feel harder because you weigh every side, yet this is an excellent period for diplomacy, collaboration, and consciously choosing who and what you mirror.

transit_sun_in_scorpio.title: Transiting Sun in Scorpio
transit_sun_in_scorpio.summary: Your core self dives into intensity, emotional depth, and the desire to transform what is hidden.
transit_sun_in_scorpio.fullText: Helios descends into the underworld realm associated with Hades. Superficiality becomes intolerable; you want truth, even if it burns. Power dynamics, shared resources, and psychological excavation come into focus. Expect heightened magnetism and a lower tolerance for half-measures or emotional dishonesty.

transit_sun_in_sagittarius.title: Transiting Sun in Sagittarius
transit_sun_in_sagittarius.summary: Your identity expands toward meaning, adventure, and a broader philosophical horizon.
transit_sun_in_sagittarius.fullText: The Sun takes on the restless, far-seeing quality of Zeus. You feel restless for growth—through travel, study, or simply bigger questions. Optimism rises, but so can dogmatism. This is a time to aim higher and trust that the path will reveal itself once you start moving.

transit_sun_in_capricorn.title: Transiting Sun in Capricorn
transit_sun_in_capricorn.summary: Your sense of self becomes more ambitious, disciplined, and oriented toward long-term achievement.
transit_sun_in_capricorn.fullText: Helios now climbs the mountain under the stern gaze of Kronos. Status, responsibility, and measurable progress matter more than fleeting inspiration. You may feel pressure to prove yourself through concrete results. Structure and patience become allies rather than constraints.

transit_sun_in_aquarius.title: Transiting Sun in Aquarius
transit_sun_in_aquarius.summary: Your identity shifts toward originality, collective vision, and detachment from outdated roles.
transit_sun_in_aquarius.fullText: The solar light takes on the innovative, sometimes aloof quality of Ouranos. You may feel less interested in personal glory and more drawn to ideas, groups, or future-oriented experiments. Freedom to be unconventional becomes essential; traditional expectations can feel especially confining.

transit_sun_in_pisces.title: Transiting Sun in Pisces
transit_sun_in_pisces.summary: Your core self softens into empathy, imagination, and a longing to dissolve boundaries.
transit_sun_in_pisces.fullText: Helios dissolves into the oceanic realm linked with Poseidon and the collective unconscious. Boundaries blur; intuition and compassion rise. This can be a highly creative or spiritual window, yet also one of confusion or escape if you don’t stay gently grounded. Surrender and trust become the prevailing themes.

transit_moon_in_aries.title: Transiting Moon in Aries
transit_moon_in_aries.summary: Emotions surge with impatience and a strong urge to act on feelings immediately.
transit_moon_in_aries.fullText: Selene rides with the fire of Ares, making moods quick, reactive, and hungry for independence. You may feel restless or irritable if held back, and emotional needs demand swift expression rather than quiet processing. This is a short window for bold emotional honesty, though tempers can flare faster than usual.

transit_moon_in_taurus.title: Transiting Moon in Taurus
transit_moon_in_taurus.summary: Feelings settle into a slower, more sensual, and security-focused rhythm.
transit_moon_in_taurus.fullText: The Moon moves through Aphrodite’s earthy domain, craving comfort, stability, and physical reassurance. Emotional well-being is closely tied to the senses—good food, touch, beauty, and financial calm. Resistance to change increases; you prefer what is familiar and proven to soothe the heart.

transit_moon_in_gemini.title: Transiting Moon in Gemini
transit_moon_in_gemini.summary: Emotions become lighter, more curious, and easily shifted by new information or conversation.
transit_moon_in_gemini.fullText: Selene borrows the quicksilver mind of Hermes. Feelings move fast and are easily distracted; talking things out often brings relief. You may notice heightened nervous energy or a need for mental stimulation to stay emotionally balanced. Depth can feel elusive, but variety keeps the mood buoyant.

transit_moon_in_cancer.title: Transiting Moon in Cancer
transit_moon_in_cancer.summary: Emotional sensitivity peaks as the need for safety, belonging, and nurturing intensifies.
transit_moon_in_cancer.fullText: The Moon returns to her own sign under the influence of Selene and the protective waters. Moods run deeper and more protective; home, family, and emotional memory take center stage. You may feel more vulnerable or nostalgic, yet also more capable of offering and receiving genuine care.

transit_moon_in_leo.title: Transiting Moon in Leo
transit_moon_in_leo.summary: Feelings seek warmth, recognition, and creative or dramatic expression.
transit_moon_in_leo.fullText: Selene shines with the proud radiance of Apollo’s light. Emotions want to be seen and appreciated; affection becomes more generous and theatrical. Pride and heart are closely linked—criticism can sting more than usual, while praise fuels emotional vitality. Play and self-expression soothe the inner child.

transit_moon_in_virgo.title: Transiting Moon in Virgo
transit_moon_in_virgo.summary: Emotions turn analytical, practical, and focused on usefulness or improvement.
transit_moon_in_virgo.fullText: The Moon adopts Hermes’ more discerning, service-oriented face. Feelings are processed through the lens of ‘what needs fixing.’ You may feel calmer when organizing, helping, or refining daily details, but self-criticism can rise if perfection is demanded of yourself or others.

transit_moon_in_libra.title: Transiting Moon in Libra
transit_moon_in_libra.summary: Emotional balance depends on harmony, fairness, and the quality of relationships.
transit_moon_in_libra.fullText: Selene moves into Aphrodite’s relational realm. You become more attuned to the emotional atmosphere between people and may avoid conflict to keep the peace. Companionship soothes, while imbalance or ugliness in relationships creates inner restlessness. Diplomacy and beauty help regulate mood.

transit_moon_in_scorpio.title: Transiting Moon in Scorpio
transit_moon_in_scorpio.summary: Emotions intensify, turning private, probing, and unwilling to settle for surface answers.
transit_moon_in_scorpio.fullText: The Moon descends into the underworld waters associated with Hades. Feelings run deep and can include suspicion, desire, or a need for emotional truth at any cost. Superficial interactions feel empty; you may withdraw or test loyalty. Transformation of buried feelings is possible if you allow the intensity rather than resist it.

transit_moon_in_sagittarius.title: Transiting Moon in Sagittarius
transit_moon_in_sagittarius.summary: Moods lift with a hunger for freedom, meaning, and emotional adventure.
transit_moon_in_sagittarius.fullText: Selene rides under the expansive sky of Zeus. Feelings seek open horizons—literally or philosophically. Restlessness or optimism can color the day; small emotional cages feel especially confining. Humor, exploration, and a bigger perspective help keep the heart light and resilient.

transit_moon_in_capricorn.title: Transiting Moon in Capricorn
transit_moon_in_capricorn.summary: Emotions become more reserved, responsible, and oriented toward long-term emotional security.
transit_moon_in_capricorn.fullText: The Moon climbs the mountain under Kronos’ disciplined gaze. Feelings are tempered by duty and the need for control. You may appear cooler or more pragmatic, prioritizing achievement or structure over emotional display. Quiet competence and reliable effort soothe the inner world more than open vulnerability.

transit_moon_in_aquarius.title: Transiting Moon in Aquarius
transit_moon_in_aquarius.summary: Emotional needs shift toward detachment, originality, and connection through ideas or groups.
transit_moon_in_aquarius.fullText: Selene takes on the cool, innovative quality of Ouranos. Personal feelings may feel secondary to the larger picture or collective mood. You can observe your emotions with unusual objectivity, which is freeing yet sometimes isolating. Friendship and shared ideals nourish more than intense one-on-one intimacy right now.

transit_moon_in_pisces.title: Transiting Moon in Pisces
transit_moon_in_pisces.summary: Emotions become porous, imaginative, and highly sensitive to the surrounding atmosphere.
transit_moon_in_pisces.fullText: The Moon dissolves into the oceanic realm of Poseidon. Boundaries soften; compassion and intuition rise while clarity can blur. You may absorb others’ feelings easily or seek escape through fantasy, art, or solitude. Gentle self-care and creative outlets help navigate the emotional tides without becoming overwhelmed.

transit_mercury_in_aries.title: Transiting Mercury in Aries
transit_mercury_in_aries.summary: Thinking and communication become direct, impatient, and action-oriented.
transit_mercury_in_aries.fullText: Hermes borrows the spear of Ares. Ideas arrive hot and fast; you prefer blunt honesty over careful phrasing. Decisions speed up and debates can turn competitive. This is excellent for initiating conversations or cutting through hesitation, though tact may temporarily leave the building.

transit_mercury_in_taurus.title: Transiting Mercury in Taurus
transit_mercury_in_taurus.summary: The mind slows down, favoring practical, sensory, and deliberate thought.
transit_mercury_in_taurus.fullText: Hermes walks the steady paths of Aphrodite’s earth. Thinking becomes more methodical and grounded in what can be seen, touched, or proven useful. You resist rushed conclusions and prefer ideas that build lasting value. Stubborn mental habits can surface, but so can patient, productive focus.

transit_mercury_in_gemini.title: Transiting Mercury in Gemini
transit_mercury_in_gemini.summary: Mental energy peaks with curiosity, versatility, and a hunger for information exchange.
transit_mercury_in_gemini.fullText: Hermes returns to his own agile domain. The mind is quick, playful, and easily stimulated by new data or conversations. Multitasking feels natural, though depth may suffer if you scatter attention too widely. This is a strong window for learning, writing, networking, and verbal agility.

transit_mercury_in_cancer.title: Transiting Mercury in Cancer
transit_mercury_in_cancer.summary: Thoughts and speech become more emotional, protective, and memory-laden.
transit_mercury_in_cancer.fullText: Hermes enters the tidal waters watched by Selene. Logic softens under the influence of feeling; you communicate from the heart and may revisit the past more than usual. Subjective impressions color perception. Gentle, nurturing conversations land best, while cold analysis can feel jarring.

transit_mercury_in_leo.title: Transiting Mercury in Leo
transit_mercury_in_leo.summary: Communication takes on warmth, flair, and a desire to be heard and appreciated.
transit_mercury_in_leo.fullText: Hermes speaks with the dramatic voice of Apollo. Ideas want an audience; storytelling, persuasion, and creative expression come more easily. Pride can color opinions, making criticism harder to receive. This is a strong period for confident self-expression and inspiring others through words.

transit_mercury_in_virgo.title: Transiting Mercury in Virgo
transit_mercury_in_virgo.summary: The mind becomes precise, analytical, and focused on detail and improvement.
transit_mercury_in_virgo.fullText: Hermes sharpens his tools in his own critical domain. Thinking turns methodical and service-oriented; you notice what is inefficient or incomplete. Excellent for editing, planning, research, and practical problem-solving. The shadow is over-analysis or harsh self-talk if perfection is demanded.

transit_mercury_in_libra.title: Transiting Mercury in Libra
transit_mercury_in_libra.summary: Thoughts and dialogue seek balance, fairness, and harmonious exchange.
transit_mercury_in_libra.fullText: Hermes enters Aphrodite’s relational sphere. The mind weighs both sides carefully and prefers diplomatic language. Indecision can increase because every perspective feels valid. This is a favorable time for negotiations, aesthetic discussions, and conversations that aim for mutual understanding.

transit_mercury_in_scorpio.title: Transiting Mercury in Scorpio
transit_mercury_in_scorpio.summary: Thinking deepens, becoming probing, strategic, and unwilling to accept surface answers.
transit_mercury_in_scorpio.fullText: Hermes descends into the underworld realm of Hades. Curiosity turns investigative; you want the hidden motives and unspoken truths. Communication can become intense, private, or even suspicious. This is powerful for research, psychological insight, and transformative conversations, but light banter may feel empty.

transit_mercury_in_sagittarius.title: Transiting Mercury in Sagittarius
transit_mercury_in_sagittarius.summary: The mind expands toward big ideas, meaning, and far-reaching perspectives.
transit_mercury_in_sagittarius.fullText: Hermes rides with the broad vision of Zeus. Thinking becomes more philosophical, optimistic, and restless for larger truths. Details may be glossed over in favor of the bigger picture. Excellent for teaching, travel planning, publishing, or any mental pursuit that promises growth and freedom.

transit_mercury_in_capricorn.title: Transiting Mercury in Capricorn
transit_mercury_in_capricorn.summary: Thought processes turn serious, structured, and oriented toward long-term goals.
transit_mercury_in_capricorn.fullText: Hermes climbs under the disciplined authority of Kronos. The mind favors practical strategy, responsibility, and measurable results. Communication becomes more formal or authoritative. This is strong for planning, professional writing, and serious decision-making, though humor and spontaneity may temporarily recede.

transit_mercury_in_aquarius.title: Transiting Mercury in Aquarius
transit_mercury_in_aquarius.summary: Thinking becomes original, detached, and oriented toward future possibilities and group ideas.
transit_mercury_in_aquarius.fullText: Hermes adopts the inventive, unconventional spark of Ouranos. The mind seeks novelty, progressive concepts, and intellectual independence. You may feel less interested in personal drama and more drawn to systems, technology, or collective visions. Brilliant insights are possible, alongside a cooler emotional tone in conversation.

transit_mercury_in_pisces.title: Transiting Mercury in Pisces
transit_mercury_in_pisces.summary: The mind softens into intuition, imagination, and non-linear perception.
transit_mercury_in_pisces.fullText: Hermes dissolves into the oceanic realm of Poseidon. Logic yields to impression, symbol, and feeling. Communication can become poetic, vague, or highly empathetic. This is a fertile time for creative writing, spiritual insight, and compassionate listening, though clear facts and boundaries may temporarily blur.

transit_venus_in_aries.title: Transiting Venus in Aries
transit_venus_in_aries.summary: Desire and relating become more direct, passionate, and self-assertive.
transit_venus_in_aries.fullText: Aphrodite takes up the bold energy of Ares. Attraction is instant and you pursue what you want with little hesitation. Relationships favor independence and excitement over slow cultivation. This is a strong window for initiating romance or creative projects, though patience and compromise may feel harder to access.

transit_venus_in_taurus.title: Transiting Venus in Taurus
transit_venus_in_taurus.summary: Love, pleasure, and values slow down into steady, sensual, and security-oriented expression.
transit_venus_in_taurus.fullText: Aphrodite returns to her own earthy domain. Affection is shown through consistency, touch, and tangible gifts. You crave reliability and physical comfort in relationships and finances. Loyalty deepens, but so can possessiveness if change threatens what feels solid and beautiful.

transit_venus_in_gemini.title: Transiting Venus in Gemini
transit_venus_in_gemini.summary: Attraction and social connection become lighter, more curious, and mentally stimulating.
transit_venus_in_gemini.fullText: Aphrodite borrows the playful curiosity of Hermes. Flirtation, conversation, and variety keep the heart engaged. You may prefer multiple connections or intellectual rapport over intense emotional merging. This is excellent for social ease and creative brainstorming, though deeper commitment can feel less urgent.

transit_venus_in_cancer.title: Transiting Venus in Cancer
transit_venus_in_cancer.summary: Love and values turn protective, nurturing, and focused on emotional safety.
transit_venus_in_cancer.fullText: Aphrodite enters the tidal waters watched by Selene. Affection is expressed through caretaking, loyalty, and creating a sense of home. You may feel more sensitive to rejection and drawn to people or situations that feel familiar and emotionally secure. Family and private bonds take on heightened importance.

transit_venus_in_leo.title: Transiting Venus in Leo
transit_venus_in_leo.summary: Desire seeks warmth, admiration, and dramatic or creative expression.
transit_venus_in_leo.fullText: Aphrodite shines under the radiant influence of Apollo. Love becomes more generous, playful, and theatrical; you want to be adored and to adore in return. Creative projects and romantic gestures flourish. Pride can color relationships—both the gift of loyalty and the vulnerability to feeling unappreciated.

transit_venus_in_virgo.title: Transiting Venus in Virgo
transit_venus_in_virgo.summary: Affection and values become more discerning, practical, and service-oriented.
transit_venus_in_virgo.fullText: Aphrodite adopts Hermes’ careful, refining eye. Love is shown through helpful acts, attention to detail, and quiet competence. You may become more critical of imperfections in relationships or aesthetics. This is a strong period for improving daily pleasures and health-related self-care, though perfectionism can cool spontaneous warmth.

transit_venus_in_libra.title: Transiting Venus in Libra
transit_venus_in_libra.summary: Relating and aesthetics seek harmony, fairness, and mutual beauty.
transit_venus_in_libra.fullText: Aphrodite returns to her own airy domain of balance. Partnerships, diplomacy, and refined taste take center stage. You are more willing to compromise and more sensitive to discord or ugliness. This is an excellent window for improving relationships and surrounding yourself with beauty, though indecision can arise from wanting every side to feel equal.

transit_venus_in_scorpio.title: Transiting Venus in Scorpio
transit_venus_in_scorpio.summary: Desire deepens into intensity, emotional truth, and transformative connection.
transit_venus_in_scorpio.fullText: Aphrodite descends into the underworld realm of Hades. Superficial attraction loses its appeal; you want depth, loyalty, and soul-level merging. Jealousy, power dynamics, and shared resources may surface. This can be a powerfully magnetic and healing period if you are willing to face what is hidden in love and values.

transit_venus_in_sagittarius.title: Transiting Venus in Sagittarius
transit_venus_in_sagittarius.summary: Love and pleasure expand toward freedom, adventure, and shared meaning.
transit_venus_in_sagittarius.fullText: Aphrodite rides under the expansive sky of Zeus. Attraction favors optimism, humor, and growth-oriented connections. You may feel restless for new experiences or philosophical rapport in relationships. This is a buoyant time for romance and creativity that broadens horizons, though commitment to one path can feel temporarily limiting.

transit_venus_in_capricorn.title: Transiting Venus in Capricorn
transit_venus_in_capricorn.summary: Values and relating become more serious, responsible, and oriented toward lasting achievement.
transit_venus_in_capricorn.fullText: Aphrodite climbs under the disciplined gaze of Kronos. Affection is expressed through reliability, respect, and shared ambition. You may prefer mature or status-conscious connections and take a longer view of love and resources. Romance can feel cooler but more enduring if built on mutual respect and practical foundations.

transit_venus_in_aquarius.title: Transiting Venus in Aquarius
transit_venus_in_aquarius.summary: Attraction and values shift toward originality, friendship, and unconventional freedom.
transit_venus_in_aquarius.fullText: Aphrodite takes on the innovative, detached spark of Ouranos. Love prefers space, intellectual connection, and progressive ideals over traditional romance. You may feel drawn to unusual people or group settings. Emotional independence increases, which can be liberating yet sometimes leave closer intimacy feeling secondary.

transit_venus_in_pisces.title: Transiting Venus in Pisces
transit_venus_in_pisces.summary: Desire softens into compassion, idealism, and a longing for transcendent connection.
transit_venus_in_pisces.fullText: Aphrodite dissolves into the oceanic realm of Poseidon. Love becomes more empathetic, imaginative, and boundary-blurring. You may idealize partners or seek spiritual and artistic merging. This is a highly romantic and creative window, though clarity about realistic expectations can temporarily fade.

transit_mars_in_aries.title: Transiting Mars in Aries
transit_mars_in_aries.summary: Drive and assertiveness peak with raw courage, impatience, and a need to act first.
transit_mars_in_aries.fullText: Ares returns to his own fiery domain. Energy is high, competitive, and eager to initiate. You feel less tolerance for delays or passive behavior and may push harder to claim what you want. This is excellent for bold starts, though impulse and short tempers require conscious management.

transit_mars_in_taurus.title: Transiting Mars in Taurus
transit_mars_in_taurus.summary: Motivation slows into steady, determined, and physically grounded effort.
transit_mars_in_taurus.fullText: Ares walks the solid earth of Aphrodite. Action becomes more deliberate and persistent; once committed, you dig in and resist being rushed. Physical stamina and the drive to build tangible security increase. Stubbornness can rise, but so can reliable, long-haul productivity.

transit_mars_in_gemini.title: Transiting Mars in Gemini
transit_mars_in_gemini.summary: Energy scatters into quick mental activity, debate, and multiple directions at once.
transit_mars_in_gemini.fullText: Ares borrows the agile mind of Hermes. Drive expresses through words, ideas, and restless movement. You may feel mentally sharp and argumentative, preferring variety over sustained focus. This is strong for learning, networking, and verbal assertion, though follow-through on single projects can suffer.

transit_mars_in_cancer.title: Transiting Mars in Cancer
transit_mars_in_cancer.summary: Assertiveness becomes emotionally charged, protective, and indirectly expressed.
transit_mars_in_cancer.fullText: Ares enters the tidal waters of Selene. Motivation is fueled by feeling and the need to defend what feels like home or family. Direct confrontation may give way to moodiness or passive resistance. Energy fluctuates with emotional security; when safe, you fight hard for those you care about.

transit_mars_in_leo.title: Transiting Mars in Leo
transit_mars_in_leo.summary: Drive seeks creative expression, recognition, and confident self-assertion.
transit_mars_in_leo.fullText: Ares shines under the radiant influence of Apollo. Action becomes more dramatic, proud, and heart-centered. You want to lead or create something that reflects your unique fire. Generosity and playfulness rise, but so can ego sensitivity if efforts go unnoticed or unappreciated.

transit_mars_in_virgo.title: Transiting Mars in Virgo
transit_mars_in_virgo.summary: Energy turns precise, industrious, and focused on improvement and practical results.
transit_mars_in_virgo.fullText: Ares adopts Hermes’ discriminating tools. Motivation is channeled into efficient work, problem-solving, and refining systems or health. You may feel driven to fix what is imperfect. This is excellent for detailed tasks and service, though irritability can surface if standards feel unmet.

transit_mars_in_libra.title: Transiting Mars in Libra
transit_mars_in_libra.summary: Assertiveness seeks balance, fairness, and cooperative or aesthetic outlets.
transit_mars_in_libra.fullText: Ares enters Aphrodite’s relational domain. Direct aggression softens in favor of strategy, negotiation, and shared goals. You may hesitate before acting in order to weigh the impact on others. This is strong for diplomacy and partnership efforts, though indecision or suppressed anger can build if harmony is forced.

transit_mars_in_scorpio.title: Transiting Mars in Scorpio
transit_mars_in_scorpio.summary: Drive intensifies into focused, strategic, and emotionally charged determination.
transit_mars_in_scorpio.fullText: Ares descends into the underworld realm of Hades. Willpower becomes magnetic and relentless; half-measures feel intolerable. You may pursue goals with secrecy or psychological depth. This is a powerful period for transformation and reclaiming personal power, though obsession or power struggles require awareness.

transit_mars_in_sagittarius.title: Transiting Mars in Sagittarius
transit_mars_in_sagittarius.summary: Energy expands toward adventure, belief, and far-reaching action.
transit_mars_in_sagittarius.fullText: Ares rides under the broad sky of Zeus. Motivation is fueled by meaning, freedom, and the desire to explore. You feel restless for bigger challenges and may act with greater optimism or blunt honesty. This is excellent for travel, teaching, or bold philosophical stands, though overconfidence can appear.

transit_mars_in_capricorn.title: Transiting Mars in Capricorn
transit_mars_in_capricorn.summary: Drive becomes disciplined, ambitious, and oriented toward long-term achievement.
transit_mars_in_capricorn.fullText: Ares climbs under the stern authority of Kronos. Energy is channeled into structured effort, responsibility, and measurable progress. You feel more willing to endure hardship for lasting results. This is a strong window for professional advancement and strategic action, though emotional warmth may temporarily take a back seat.

transit_mars_in_aquarius.title: Transiting Mars in Aquarius
transit_mars_in_aquarius.summary: Assertiveness turns original, detached, and oriented toward collective or future-oriented goals.
transit_mars_in_aquarius.fullText: Ares takes on the innovative spark of Ouranos. Motivation is fueled by ideals, independence, and the desire to disrupt outdated patterns. You may act more for the group or a cause than for personal glory. This is excellent for progressive projects and intellectual courage, though emotional coolness can appear in close relationships.

transit_mars_in_pisces.title: Transiting Mars in Pisces
transit_mars_in_pisces.summary: Drive softens into intuition, compassion, and less direct forms of action.
transit_mars_in_pisces.fullText: Ares dissolves into the oceanic realm of Poseidon. Assertiveness becomes more fluid, imaginative, or sacrificial. You may feel less competitive and more motivated by empathy or creative inspiration. Energy can feel diffuse; clear goals help prevent drift, while spiritual or artistic outlets provide productive channels.

transit_jupiter_in_aries.title: Transiting Jupiter in Aries
transit_jupiter_in_aries.summary: Growth and opportunity arrive through bold initiative, courage, and self-directed action.
transit_jupiter_in_aries.fullText: Zeus rides with the pioneering fire of Ares. Confidence expands and you feel more willing to take risks or start something new under your own name. Optimism fuels independence. This is a strong period for personal leadership and pioneering ventures, though overconfidence or impatience can appear if unchecked.

transit_jupiter_in_taurus.title: Transiting Jupiter in Taurus
transit_jupiter_in_taurus.summary: Expansion focuses on material security, sensory pleasure, and steady accumulation of resources.
transit_jupiter_in_taurus.fullText: Zeus walks the fertile fields of Aphrodite’s earth. Growth comes through patience, practical investments, and appreciating what endures. You may feel more generous with money or comforts and more protective of financial stability. This is excellent for building lasting wealth or refining values, though excess or stubbornness around possessions can arise.
